summary: Discussion snapshot: multi-agent workspaces and memory/MCP patterns gaining traction; security/sandbox escapes and prompt-injection risks drive operator concern; vendor products (OpenHands, Zed, OpenAI Dots, AWS memory patterns) surface in social threads. | Vendor-first snapshot: multiple mainstream vendors released agent/features (Cursor, Anthropic, MS, AWS, Cloudflare). Sandboxes and runtime scaling updates from Daytona, Modal, E2B; a GHSA security advisory affects n8n. Missing independent social/operator reports. | GitHub OSS snapshot: multiple high-traction agent harnesses and vendor releases + MCP/tooling activity. No social/operator field reports in this shard—need independent user feedback and cross-platform corroboration. | Package-only signals: multiple vendor packages (OpenAI, Amazon) and several infra primitives (MCP, sandbox, memory, policy-as-code). No social/user-field reports in this shard; many items need corroboration.
